task.title: Altana/Pancake autonomous-session least-authority audit
task.exactDefinition: Given one immutable, secret-free BNB Smart Chain testnet activation review bundle containing a serialized Altana grant intent, decoded Pancake direct calls, code/selector attestation, spend and expiry policy, durable reservation/claim state, quote timestamps, authority lifecycle receipts, documented SDK 0.7.0 behavior, and a pre-frozen adversarial mutation corpus, identify every authority path and defect; assign severity and reproducible impact; and produce a corrected enforcement table split across Altana/onchain, ProofEra runtime, and explicit wallet confirmation. The timed audit is read-only.
task.successCondition: Both methods inspect the byte-identical bundle and return a complete, evidence-linked finding set plus corrected least-authority policy, retry rule, revoke path, and limitations; a second reviewer can reproduce each finding without a secret or live write.

inputs.description: Canonical serialized grant intent, direct-call plan, wallet/recipient/token/amount/deadline/slippage policy, worker bootstrap state, durable reservation identifier, and claim state with all secret material removed.
inputs.authoritativeSourceRequirement: Hashed output from the reviewed ProofEra server-only activation composition boundary.
inputs.bindingRule: Bind one proposal that passed structural parsing but preserve any intentionally seeded policy defects in the separately indexed adversarial corpus; never include signer, passkey, private key, API key, or opaque secret handle.

constraints.description: All authority and receipt evidence must identify BNB Smart Chain testnet chain ID 97.
The supplied corpus and every output must exclude private keys, passkey material, session signers, wallet passwords, API keys and opaque secret handles.
Neither timed method may sign, grant, revoke, mutate a database, submit, or broadcast.
Every corrected permission must name its actual enforcement layer rather than treating application validation as an onchain guarantee.
Finish the timed audit within 1200 seconds; later completion remains recorded and loses the timing/reproducibility points.

criteria.description: Find the seeded and naturally present authority, replay, freshness, retry, revoke and secret-boundary defects.
criteria.measurement: Compare normalized finding IDs and severities with the frozen reviewer-held answer key.
criteria.evidenceRequired: Raw report, normalized finding table, corpus digest and answer-key scoring trace.

criteria.description: Avoid claims not supported by code, receipts, SDK evidence or the frozen proposal.
criteria.measurement: Review every claimed issue against exact source evidence and count unsupported or duplicate findings.
criteria.evidenceRequired: Finding-to-source join table and reviewer adjudication.

criteria.description: Explain concrete impact, preconditions and safe reproduction without exposing or using secrets.
criteria.measurement: Execute approved read-only reproductions against the frozen corpus and compare observed states.
criteria.evidenceRequired: Reproduction log, artifact hashes and observed read-only outputs.

criteria.description: Produce a complete corrected policy with accurate enforcement layer, spend, selector, target, expiry, retry and revoke controls.
criteria.measurement: Apply a fixed checklist and validate the corrected canonical policy against the frozen safety schema.
criteria.evidenceRequired: Corrected policy, schema result and reviewer checklist.

criteria.description: Provide complete hashes, source joins, timing, costs, limitations and deterministic normalized findings.
criteria.measurement: Second reviewer reproduces the normalized report and validates every evidence reference.
criteria.evidenceRequired: Raw/canonical outputs, active/wall timing, cost evidence, receipt joins and verification log.

hardFailRules: Any private key, passkey material, session signer, wallet password, API key, secret handle, or usable credential appears in an input, output, log, artifact, or command.
Failure to identify a seeded generic dispatcher, session-signer leak, wrong target/recipient/token/chain, unbounded spend, unsafe unknown-outcome retry, or missing revoke path.
Any live write, signature, grant, revoke, submission, broadcast, database mutation, or corpus/answer-key change during either timed audit.
Any input, constraint, environment, source access, rubric, or answer-key difference between methods.

pairProtocol.runOrderRule: Freeze the corpus, private answer-key digest, shared declaration and source bundle first; then use recorded public randomness to choose order without changing any artifact between runs.
pairProtocol.agentMethodRequirement: Hire the registered security/audit service through ProofEra and invoke only its frozen configuration against the shared secret-free bundle; retain hire evidence separately from scored findings.
pairProtocol.manualMethodRequirement: One declared security reviewer audits the same bundle without invoking the hired agent, using only the predeclared local inspection tools and frozen documentation.

artifactRequirements.description: Byte-identical declaration, proposal, corpus and source evidence supplied to both methods.
Unedited report plus canonical normalized finding and corrected-policy outputs.
UTC/monotonic wall time, active-time segments, tool-use log and sourced cost items including evidenced zeroes.
Post-run answer-key reveal, finding adjudication and second-reviewer scoring.
Raw ProofEra hire/activation evidence for the registered audit service; excluded from quality scoring.
Exact reviewer procedure and tools showing that the hired agent was not invoked.

receiptRequirements.description: The exact testnet grant/revoke transaction under audit, re-observed inside each run and joined to a hashed raw receipt artifact.
Raw RPC/explorer response used to confirm target code and current/revoked authority inside each run.
Explorer-verifiable testnet hire/activation receipt for the registered audit service; without it, the pair is not publishable.
